results.title: How Stanford researchers design reliable, human-focused AI systems
results.content: * Stanford computer scientists Ludwig Schmidt and Diyi Yang help develop the foundations of AI tools – such as building the training data needed to create and improve a variety of algorithms to power AI systems. “We want to build AI models for humans,” said Yang, who leads the Social and Language Technologies Lab, which specializes in socially aware natural language processing, large language models, and human-AI interactions. “Our lab is working to make AI models more inclusive so they can understand more languages in general, and we hope to build AI systems that understand the different regional languages so that people in, for example, New York, San Francisco, and Atlanta can experience the technology in the same way and have a positive experience with AI,” said Yang. Yang’s interest in human-centered AI extends to building and testing tools, such as large language models that are designed to help people improve their social skills.
